velora_location.message: Velora is at 5850 McLeod Road in Niagara Falls. It is within walking distance of Niagara Falls and close to golf, parks, shopping, dining and everyday essentials.

home_types.message: Velora currently presents three home types.

type1.message: Type 1 is a traditional townhome designed for growing families seeking comfort and connected living.

type2.message: Type 2 is a back-to-back townhome designed for efficient, contemporary living.

type3.message: Type 3 is a stacked townhome offering smartly designed urban living with elegant functionality.

velora_lifestyle.message: Velora is planned around greenery, walkability and modern living, balancing nature, convenience and a strong sense of community.

hst.message: The Velora website currently highlights Ontario’s temporary HST relief for eligible new homes, with the current program scheduled to remain available until March 2027. Imara’s sales team can explain eligibility and how it may apply.

story.message: Imara Homes is a residential brand focused on thoughtfully planned communities, quality, care and long-term value. Its team brings more than a decade of construction-industry experience.

values.message: Imara brings development and construction expertise together, with a focus on exceptional locations, timeless design, meaningful amenities, quality craftsmanship and communities people are proud to call home.

auri.message: Auri is the spirit behind every Imara community — a mascot and guide representing thoughtful planning, discovery and connection.

parks.message: Nearby nature includes Heartland Forest Nature Experience, John N. Allan Park, Garner Neighbourhood Park, Kingsbridge Park, Dufferin Islands Nature Area, Fallsview Trail and Niagara River Recreation Trail.

shopping.message: Nearby shopping and essentials include SmartCentres Niagara Falls, Walmart Supercentre, Costco, RONA, Niagara Square Shopping Centre, FreshCo, Food Basics and Outlet Collection at Niagara.

healthcare.message: Nearby healthcare includes Niagara Falls Urgent Care Centre, Greater Niagara General Hospital and the upcoming South Niagara Hospital.

schools.message: Nearby schools listed by Imara include Lundy’s Lane Public School, St. Michael Catholic High School, Forestview Public School and A.N. Myer Secondary School.

entertainment.message: Nearby entertainment includes Fallsview Casino Resort, Clifton Hill, Casino Niagara, Niagara SkyWheel, Great Canadian Midway, Niagara Speedway, Niagara Helicopter Tours, Niagara Parks Floral Clock and Niagara Wine Country.

connectivity.message: Nearby connectivity includes the QEW McLeod Interchange, Niagara Falls GO Terminal, VIA Rail Station and Niagara District Airport.
